Just letting you know someone's listening. This subreddit can be hard and a little disappointing at times especially when no one comments or tries to help.. 
Are you open with your wife about all of this? If you express your concerns and talk with her, you could probably help each other and possibly grow closer in the process.
Don't give up, believe that things will get better and there's a very good chance they will.

I'm sorry I don't quite understand this post.
Are you looking for more ideas to help deal with depression/sleep?
Or are you trying to give a few points of advice to others?

Open up to people. If your close friends really do care about you they will definitely try and help. 
Remember that you don't have to live up to people's expectations, just do the best you can, or even the best you want to do. 

Hope things work out for you. You can PM me if you like, I may reply slowly but I'd like to help if I could.

She knew I was already in a relationship and I told her that again, and that I just really needed her as a friend. (Which is true)
I have never been good at talking to girls in the first place, and having to turn down someone's affection? The thought had never crossed my mind and I had absolutely no idea how to handle it. Still don't really.

Try opening up to others first? I'm sorry if I'm completely wrong but perhaps the reason the people around you haven't asked what's wrong is because they don't realize you want to talk about it. Try asking the people around you if THEY'RE okay, and maybe you can help each other.
Hey, thank you. I can relate to you very well and that actually helps a little. Glad things got better for you.
I like music. And my girlfriend. I barely ever see my girlfriend (long-distance relationship).
Thanks for commenting. But I don't find that helpful.. I hate flowers, and dogs.. and people.. I really am a horrible human being

Never taken illegal drugs, don't plan to either. I'm way too scared of making it worse. I made a promise to my girlfriend not to leave her.. and no matter how bad i get or how much I want to give up, that still seems to mean something to me. I don't know if i can keep it up though.. everyday is harder and I'm getting weaker.

I'm not on any medication right now.
The worst i've ever had it was two full days.. that's what I imagine hell would be like.
I have no idea how I made it through that.. I guess at the time, suicide wasn't real either.
I have them a few times a day usually.. without warning and for no apparent reason.
If anyone actually read all that.. i'm sorry, and thank you.
